# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. The guide’s state-tax percentage, fees, temporary-plate duration, transfer/address deadlines, seizure cure periods, renewal timing and inspection-program applicability require current issuer/legal verification. Its less-than-ten-year federal odometer rule may be stale and is withheld pending the applicable model-year/current federal rule. Do not equate registration alone with conclusive legal ownership despite the guide’s wording. The municipal inspection reference is a description of the snapshot, not present-day clearance. Preserve explicit currentness debt for the entire administrative section; no transaction advice or current pricing is claimed. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
